reason: At a fixed 30-second post-trigger boundary on fresh Explorer processes, Element Template retains 6.5655x the latest-upstream Native heap allocation and 1.1492x the merged automatic-core allocation. The exact frozen M0-current bundle mounts no Native controls on either Explorer 4.1 or source-built Lynx develop, so it cannot provide an unpatched Native memory baseline. These findings block default/formal qualification; no latency score is assigned to latest upstream because that artifact has only legacy-public-source timing capability.

m0CurrentNativeDnf.sourceInference: The frozen e82160f benchmark module constructs MessageChannel unconditionally at module scope, while the later upstream fixture added a Native setTimeout fallback. The repeated blank page is consistent with that source difference, but no console exception was captured, so this remains an inference rather than a verified error string.
m0CurrentNativeDnf.interpretation: The exact unpatched M0-current Native comparator is unavailable on both tested runtimes. A patched/rebuilt fixture would be a separate identity and cannot silently replace it.

invalidScreens.reason: ET memory was sampled immediately after ACK while upstream memory was sampled after a 30-second timing timeout; excluded because the settle boundary differed.
Valid immediate post-ACK ET-vs-merged screen, retained only as peak-direction guidance; not mixed with fixed-30-second settled values.
